name: Apatura Ltd
ownership_summary: UK energy storage and data centre developer with offices in York and Edinburgh; promotes multiple Scottish data centre projects (Ravenscraig, Wester Hermiston, Coldstream, Freeport West Lothian, Ochiltree, Westerhill).

name: Apatura DC Project 6 Ltd
ownership_summary: SPV incorporated 28 Oct 2024, registered office 3rd Floor 1 Ashley Road, Altrincham WA14 2DT; SIC codes 35110/35120/35130 (electricity). Named as applicant on the PAN public notice.
notes: One of at least 12 numbered 'Apatura DC Project' SPVs at the same registered address.

name: AAH Consultants (AAH Planning)
notes: Apatura's planning consultant; named on consultation panels as supporting all Apatura planning applications.

name: East Dunbartonshire Council
notes: Planning authority for the data centre element; also promoter of the Westerhill Regeneration Area masterplan and Westerhill Development Road under the Glasgow City Region City Deal.

name: Scottish Government Energy Consents Unit
notes: Intended consenting authority for the 500MW BESS via section 36 of the Electricity Act 1989.

name: National Energy System Operator (NESO)
notes: Developer states a formal grid connection agreement/offer was accepted with NESO in June 2025; connection proposed to Lambhill substation. Not independently verified.

name: Action to Protect Rural Scotland (APRS)
notes: Tracks the proposal as part of its data centres campaign; calls for a moratorium on hyperscale AI data centres in Scotland.
